opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment helping people with disabilities live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially transitions from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from CQC. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance open to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment supporting places providing excellent care to patients and their families in hospices and palliative care.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Grants for refurbishing or creating galleries and education/learning spaces to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority organisation focused on professional performance, able to make a case for the significance of its education work. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for building or refurbishing training and education facilities of performing arts organisations, and occasionally for related specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for refurbishing or creating galleries and education/learning spaces to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, at least a 'good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment or equipment for special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting development of skills for employment or independent living at secondary/post-16 level.

opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities or research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant £15,000; maximum grant £100,000; usual range £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK with at least two years of exam results and a 'Good' or above inspection rating.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new build, refurbishment or technical equipment to improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts). One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
